slug: 2026-04-13 Helios Towers completes 133 UCSAF sites to expand rural connectivity in Tanzania

facts.fact: Helios Towers completed 133 telecom sites under Tanzania's government-led Universal Communications Service Access Fund (UCSAF) programme to extend connectivity to rural and underserved communities, per Tech Review Africa.

The UCSAF programme is described as a government-led initiative extending telecommunications infrastructure to areas where connectivity has been limited or commercially unviable, per Tech Review Africa.

facts.fact: The report says the Universal Communications Service Access Fund (UCSAF, since 2006) has expanded ICT access to rural and underserved areas, with no sites counted.
UCSAF Director General Peter Mwasalyanda said completed projects had reached 1,661 wards, 4,570 villages and 25,148,031 people, with 1,810 towers completed.
UCSAF Director General Peter Mwasalyanda said the fund facilitated 1,810 towers across 1,661 wards, connecting more than 25 million people.
Minister Jerry Silaa told the National Assembly that UCSAF plans to build telecom towers in 280 villages with mobile access difficulties in 2025/26.
UCSAF's CEO said as of March 2025 430 of the 758 towers of the Digital Tanzania Project had been built and were serving rural residents, to cover 713 wards in 127 districts.

facts.fact: The Citizen reports UCSAF's November 2026 implementation report shows 2,199 of 2,324 planned communication towers completed across 31 regions, reaching 2,053 of 2,306 targeted wards, with 758 towers in one programme switched on for 713 wards.

UCSAF director general Albert Mwakabwale said 198 locations were identified under Phase 11A after tendering, with contracts being prepared and 82 more locations due in a tender in January or February 2027.
